!!Sorry, everyone. Unfortunately, I do not have access to a proper exploit and will not be spending money on one in the near future. As a result, I am unable to develop any further updates.!!

This Chat Translator script for Roblox allows users to translate chat messages between different languages. Users can enable or disable translations for both incoming and outgoing messages. This version is a modified "fork" of the widely known Chat Translator, updated to support the new Chat System (while still compatible with the old system) and ported to the latest Google Translation API. Remember, this is an ALPHA version, and it is not very user-friendly.

Requirements:
-setreadonly
-getrawmetatable
-checkcaller
-getnamecallmethod
-newcclosure

IMPORTANT: 
-If the script fails to load, check the console for common "missing channel/events" errors. If this occurs, it is most likely due to a custom chat system used by the game. (For more info use debugMode)
-This script does not technically perform the translations, so please do not complain to me about poor translation quality; direct those complaints to Google Translate.

Commands:
- `>set in/out on/off`: Toggles translation for Input/Output messages.
- `>in/out ISOCODE`: Sets the Input/Output language to the specified ISO code.

Supported ISO codes for languages are as follows (More will be added whenever I feel like typing a lot):  
`bg` (Bulgarian), `en` (English), `zh` (Chinese), `cz` (Czech), `da` (Danish), `nl` (Dutch), `et` (Estonian), `fi` (Finnish), `fr` (French), `de` (German), `el-GR` (Greek), `hu` (Hungarian), `it` (Italian), `ja` (Japanese), `ko` (Korean), `lv` (Latvian), `lt` (Lithuanian), `nb` (Norwegian), `pt-BR` (Brazilian Portuguese), `pt` (Portuguese), `ro` (Romanian), `ru` (Russian), `sk` (Slovak), `sl` (Slovenian), `sp` (Spanish), `es` (Spanish), `sv-SE` (Swedish), and `tr` (Turkish).

scripts.title: Reset button
scripts.script:
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"))
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false

-- Crear el botón "Reset"
local resetButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
resetButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 40, 0, 40)  -- Tamaño más pequeño
resetButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -20, 0.1, 0)
resetButton.Text = "Reset"
resetButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 0, 0)
resetButton.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
resetButton.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
resetButton.Parent = screenGui
resetButton.TextScaled = true
resetButton.AutoButtonColor = false
resetButton.BorderSizePixel = 0

-- Hacer el botón redondo
local corner = Instance.new("UICorner", resetButton)
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 20)  -- Radio ajustado para un botón más pequeño

-- Función para reiniciar el personaje
local function resetCharacter()
    local humanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if humanoid then humanoid.Health = 0 end
end

-- Crear el botón "X" para quitar el botón de reset
local closeButton = Instance.new("TextButton", resetButton)
closeButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 12)  -- Tamaño más pequeño
closeButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -15, 0, 0)  -- Ajustar posición
closeButton.Text = "X"
closeButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0.8, 0, 0)
closeButton.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
closeButton.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
closeButton.BorderSizePixel = 0

-- Conectar el evento del botón "X"
closeButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    resetButton:Destroy()
end)

-- Funcionalidad para arrastrar el botón
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local dragging, dragStart, startPos = false, nil, nil

resetButton.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart, startPos = input.Position, resetButton.Position

        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        resetButton.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
    end
end)

-- Conectar el evento del botón "Reset"
resetButton.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
    if not dragging then resetCharacter() end
end)
